name: IBS plus rolling-range lower-band rebound
author: u/ucals
instruments_timeframes_claimed: SPY stated in rules; daily bars
indicators: 25-day mean High-Low; IBS=(Close-Low)/(High-Low); lower band=10-day rolling High - 2.5*mean range
entry_long: At close when SPY close is below lower band and IBS < 0.30.
exit: Exit when close > prior day high.
filters: Both band breach and IBS threshold
claimed_performance: Poster claims improved variant 2.11 Sharpe, 13% annualized over 25 years, 414 trades; self-reported and optimized.
implementation_notes: Post mixes SPY entry description with QQQ performance chart and references improved dynamic-stop variant. Record original explicit fixed exit; execute next bar to avoid close lookahead.
